privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: IWMPC values your privacy. This notice explains how we use the personal information you give us through this website, in line with the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173).
privacy.draft: This is a draft. The cooperative will review and approve it before the official launch.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: We only collect the information you choose to enter in the website's forms:

items.identity: Name, mobile number, and email (if given)
items.account: Account number or member ID (if given)
items.message: Your message or description of the problem

collect.analytics: The website uses cookie-free analytics that do not identify individual visitors.

purpose.title: What we use it for
purpose.body: Your information is used only to respond to your report, inquiry, or application and to contact you about it. We do not sell it or use it for marketing.

recipients.title: Who receives it
recipients.body: Form submissions are sent by email to authorized IWMPC staff. The website itself does not store your submission in any database.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under the Data Privacy Act, you have the right to:

items.informed: Be informed about how your personal data is used
items.access: Ask for a copy of your data
items.erase: Have your data erased or its use stopped
items.complain: File a complaint with the National Privacy Commission

dpo.title: Contact us
dpo.body: For questions or requests about your data, contact our Data Protection Officer:
